description: Main application source file for the front-end of an onboarding learning platform, utilizing React and react-router-dom. It defines routing, components, context providers, and UI logic pertinent to user authentication, admin interface, onboarding steps, and dashboard.

classes.name: Footer
classes.description: Functional component rendering the footer element of the app.

classes.name: Login
classes.description: Component managing user login functionality, including form handling and authentication logic.

classes.name: Register
classes.description: Component handling user registration, including input validation and registration process.

classes.name: Logout
classes.description: Component executing user logout process and redirect.

classes.name: OnboardingWizard
classes.description: Component managing onboarding steps, integrating Documents component, and navigation.

classes.name: AdminRouteGuard
classes.description: Route guard component ensuring only admin users can access certain routes.

classes.name: AdminPage
classes.description: Admin interface for managing user roles and viewing inbox submissions.

classes.name: DocPreview
classes.description: Helper component to present document metadata and signature info.

methods.name: Login()
methods.description: Handle user login interface and logic.

methods.name: Logout()
methods.description: Run logout process and redirect user.

methods.name: AdminRouteGuard({ children })
methods.description: Protect admin routes based on user role.

methods.name: DocPreview({ doc, title })
methods.description: Display document details and signature info.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main application component orchestrating routing and layout.
